description.value: Pür & Simple is a breakfast-and-brunch franchise restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, serving creative comfort-food classics like Eggs Benedict, French toast, pancakes, and smoothies. It is one of 65+ Canadian locations in this growing chain, positioning itself as an 'upscale' daytime dining destination with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. The wide menu includes dedicated vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-sensitive categories, making it accessible to cyclists with varied dietary needs.
